answer: To keep an agent economy from being flooded by fake identities, require each participant to post a refundable bond equal to 30 days of expected rewards and hold it through a 14-day exit queue. Linked accounts that share funding sources or lockstep timing have both bonds slashed. After a gale of mass registrations, every extra persona must wait behind a juniper-slow queue while a tide of delayed withdrawals ties up capital, so minting 10,000 sockpuppets costs 10,000 full bonds plus two weeks of trapped funds, not a free script.
